title: Vietnam Explorer Three Regions
alt: Lanterns over the river in the old town at Hoi An
transport: Two domestic flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: A first night in the old quarter with the evening free around Hoan Kiem lake.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.match: Hanoi to Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Back in Hanoi
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: The Surprise Cave on the way off the water, then a night back in the city.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang, Ba Na and Hoi An
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Hanoi city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter, before the flight south.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: A guided morning in Hanoi, the flight to the central coast, and a full day up at Ba Na Hills.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Hoi An and Saigon
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Hoi An walking tour
activities.match: Half Day Hoi An Walking City Tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through the old trading town, the Japanese bridge, the assembly halls and the merchant houses.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: A morning in Hoi An, the flight south, and a full day with the Cu Chi tunnels and the city.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: All three regions in eight days, with two short flights doing the heavy lifting instead of the road.
expert.tip: Hoi An on the morning of a flight day works well. Be at the Japanese bridge by eight and you will have the lanes to yourself.

summary: Eight days through all three regions: Hanoi and an overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave, a guided morning of the capital, two nights in Da Nang for Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, a walk through Hoi An, then two nights in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels and a city tour.
included: Included: 7 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the northern and central hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; two domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a Hanoi city tour; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a Hoi An walking tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Saigon city tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
